title: Everest Base Camp Trek
priceNote: Estimated starting price per person based on double occupancy

overview: Everest Base Camp Trek is one of Nepal's most famous trekking journeys. It takes travelers through Sherpa villages, Buddhist monasteries, suspension bridges, Sagarmatha National Park, Namche Bazaar, Tengboche, Dingboche, Lobuche, Gorakshep, Everest Base Camp, and Kala Patthar.
highlights: Scenic mountain flight to Lukla
Explore Namche Bazaar and local Sherpa culture
Visit the sacred Tengboche Monastery in the clouds
Hike through Sagarmatha National Park
Stand at the foot of Mount Everest at Base Camp (5,364m)
Breathtaking sunrise panoramic view from Kala Patthar (5,545m)

itinerary.desc: Welcome to Kathmandu. Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, you will be met by our representative and transferred to your hotel.

itinerary.desc: Take an early morning scenic flight to Hillary-Tenzing airport in Lukla (2,860m). Begin trekking to Phakding village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Cross suspension bridges, enter Sagarmatha National Park, and make a steep final climb to Namche Bazaar (3,440m).

itinerary.desc: Rest day. Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Tengboche
itinerary.desc: Trek along ridge trails, descend to the river, and climb to Tengboche Monastery (3,860m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Walk past Mani stone walls, entering the dry Imja Valley to reach Dingboche (4,410m).

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Hike to Nangkartshang Peak (5,100m) for views of Makalu and Cho Oyu.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche
itinerary.desc: Walk past Thokla Pass climbers' memorial and follow the lateral moraine of the Khumbu Glacier to Lobuche (4,910m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Lobuche to Everest Base Camp and return to Gorakshep
itinerary.desc: Trek to Gorakshep (5,160m), then make the roundtrip hike to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) alongside the Khumbu Icefall.

itinerary.title: Hike to Kala Patthar and trek to Pheriche
itinerary.desc: Climb Kala Patthar (5,545m) at dawn for the finest sunrise view of Mt. Everest, Nuptse, and Lhotse, then descend to Pheriche (4,240m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Pheriche to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Retrace your steps down the valley, passing Pangboche and Tengboche before climbing back up to Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Lukla
itinerary.desc: Final day on the trail. Descend along the Dudh Koshi River and celebrate the journey in Lukla.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Take the morning scenic flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to hotel for rest.

itinerary.title: Final departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to airport for your flight back home.

faqs.q: What is the best month for this trek?
faqs.a: March to May and September to November offer clear skies, stable weather, and excellent mountain views.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is the Everest Base Camp Trek?
faqs.a: It is challenging. You should be in good physical health and capable of walking 5-7 hours daily with a light daypack.

faqs.q: Are there charging facilities along the trail?
faqs.a: Yes, teahouses offer device charging for a small fee ranging from $2 to $5 USD per device.
